login_error.failed: Couldn't log in to Spotify. Please try again.
login_error.same_browser: Start and finish the login in the same browser.

api_error.network: Couldn't reach Spotify. Check your connection, and that no browser extension is blocking Spotify, then try again.
api_error.rate_limited: Spotify is receiving too many requests right now. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
api_error.unavailable: Spotify isn't working properly right now (error {{status}}). Please try again later.
api_error.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
api_error.status_page: Check the Spotify Web API status page for known problems

search_syntax.title: Advanced Search Syntax
search_syntax.more_detail: For more detail please refer to the full project documentation.

share.description: Create a snapshot anyone with the link can view, including private playlists and Liked Songs. No Spotify login is needed. The snapshot contains track names, artists, albums and Spotify track URIs.
share.copy_failed: Could not copy automatically. Select the link and copy it manually.
share.long_link: This link contains the whole snapshot. Some messaging apps may truncate long links; if that happens, share a CSV instead.
share.too_large: This playlist is too large for a share link. Please export it as a CSV instead.
share.failed: Could not create the link. Please try again.
share.invalid: This playlist link is invalid, incomplete or unsupported. Ask the sender to copy the full link again.
share.snapshot_description: This is a snapshot, not a live playlist. Later changes in Spotify will not appear here. No Spotify login is needed to view or download it.
share.empty: This playlist snapshot has no tracks.
